name: 4Geeks Payments for WooCommerce
author: Allan Porras

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce store’s payment processing with 4Geeks Payments.
Our powerful plugin allows you to quickly and easily accept online payments, getting you up and running in minutes, not days. Say goodbye to complicated banking procedures and hello to a streamlined, efficient way to manage your revenue.

With 4Geeks Payments, you can securely process transactions from major global card brands, including Visa, MasterCard, and American Express. All your payment activities are backed by a user-friendly web Console, giving you real-time updates, transaction management, and insightful reports on the go.

We work with merchants incorporated in more than 40 countries.

Why Choose 4Geeks Payments for Your WooCommerce Store?

Our platform is engineered to simplify your operations and fuel your business growth:

  • 🚀 Ultra-Fast Onboarding (5-Minute Setup):
    Start accepting payments on your site in as little as 5 minutes. Our agile and straightforward onboarding process means no lengthy banking contracts or cumbersome paperwork is required.

  • 💳 Global Card Acceptance:
    Process payments from globally recognized card brands like Visa, MasterCard, and American Express, regardless of where your customers or their cards are based. Open your business to an international market with ease.

  • 🏦 Free Payouts to Your Bank Account:
    Receive your earnings directly into your local bank account without any additional transfer fees for payouts. For more details, check our Payouts Documentation.

  • 🌍 Multi-Currency Support:
    Expand your global reach and enhance the shopping experience for your international customers by allowing them to pay in over 20 different currencies.

  • 📊 Real-Time, Insightful Reports:
    Access detailed financial and transaction reports that are updated instantly. Monitor your sales, identify trends, and make informed business decisions directly from our intuitive web console.

  • ↩️ Hassle-Free & Free Refunds:
    Manage customer refunds effortlessly and efficiently without incurring any extra fees for processing returns.

  • 🔒 Advanced Security with 3D Secure:
    Protect your business and your customers with an added layer of security through 3D Secure authentication. This significantly reduces the risk of fraudulent transactions and builds greater trust in your online store.

  • 💬 Comprehensive Support Options:

    • Extensive Documentation: Access our comprehensive documentation 24/7 for self-service support and guidance.
    • Global Community Forums: Get swift support, ask questions, and share insights with fellow users through our active global community forums.
    • Enterprise Support: Purchase a dedicated support plan optionally.

Clear, Transparent Pricing

Enjoy a straightforward and predictable pricing model with 4Geeks Payments:

  • Standard Flat Fee: 5% + $0.50 USD per successful transaction.
  • No hidden fees, no setup costs. What you see is what you get.

Install the Plugin via WordPress Dashboard (5min):

  1. Log in to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to the Plugins menu on the left-hand sidebar and click on Add New.
  3. In the search bar on the top right, type “4Geeks Payments for WooCommerce” (or simply “4Geeks” and look for the correct plugin).
  4. Locate the “4Geeks Payments for WooCommerce” plugin in the search results.
  5. Click the Install Now button. WordPress will download and install the plugin.
  6. Once the installation is complete, click the Activate button.
  7. Click on the plugin settings or go to WooCommerce settings -> Payments -> 4Geeks.
  8. Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Settings and paste in plugin settings.

Follow this guide.

Manual

  1. Make sure that you have at least PHP Version 5.4
  2. Upload the plugin zip file in Plugins > Add New and then click “Install Now”
  3. Once installed, activate the plugin.
  4. Add your API keys in WooCommerce > Settings > Checkout.
